hook.text: A company buys office supplies from 47 different vendors. Nobody noticed they were paying 47 different prices.

buildup.text: Category management groups similar purchases together and manages them as a portfolio with one strategy.

discovery.text: By consolidating spend into categories—IT, facilities, raw materials—companies gain visibility and leverage.

twist.text: Without categories, departments buy independently. Spend fragments and savings opportunities hide.

climax.text: Companies that implement category management typically save 10–15% across their total addressable spend.

punchline.text: Group the spend. See the waste. Capture the savings.

quiz.question: What does category management do?
options: Groups purchases into strategic categories for better management
